findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Clarify in AC2 that a gate (tag-vs-required-version comparison) is the enforcement mechanism, since a literal Docker `COPY --from=<tag>` cannot be made drift-proof by construction alone.
evidence: AC2: 'A drift ... must be impossible-by-construction or caught by a gate, not left to review.'
Dockerfile.mcp:90 / reviewbot:112 / opcert:37 each hardcode a literal `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest` tag; Docker COPY --from cannot read pyproject.toml at build time
findings.finding: AC2 offers 'impossible-by-construction OR caught by a gate', but for a Dockerfile the 'impossible-by-construction' branch is not achievable: `COPY --from=<image>:<tag>` takes a literal tag that Docker cannot interpolate from pyproject.toml at build time, so drift between the tag and required-version can only be caught by a gate, not eliminated structurally (short of a build ARG plumbed from the pin, which still needs a gate to enforce it was passed). The plan should commit to the gate branch as the enforcement mechanism so the implementer does not chase an unattainable 'single-sourced' Dockerfile.
scenarios: Implementer attempts to make the Dockerfile self-derive the version and spins on an unbuildable 'impossible-by-construction' design instead of writing the gate.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a one-line positive rationale for choosing a version-tag pin plus a drift gate (e.g. it keeps the tag human-readable and textually comparable to required-version) over a digest pin or an in-image download.
evidence: The plan documents the failure mechanism in detail but the AC lines specify only outcomes ('pull a uv whose version satisfies required-version', 'SINGLE-SOURCED', 'gate fails on :latest') with no stated rationale for why this shape was chosen.
Alternatives exist: digest-pin (@sha256, more mutation-proof but not textually comparable to required-version) or reusing the local setup-uv download logic in the image.
findings.finding: The plan states no POSITIVE rationale for the chosen fix approach (pin each Dockerfile's uv image to the version tag + a drift gate). It thoroughly explains why the outage happens but never says why tag-pin+gate is preferred over, e.g., pinning by image digest (@sha256) or replacing COPY --from with the same version-pinned download the local setup-uv action already performs.
scenarios: A reviewer or implementer cannot tell whether tag-pin was chosen deliberately over digest-pin (which resists tag mutation) and may re-litigate the approach.
